_stage: Stage 2 done: nav, the header's icon-button labels, the footer, the feedback form, and the 404 page are now real keys in both locales. Longer page content (Home, Works, Store, Journal, About, Privacy, Terms) stays hardcoded English for now — that's prose, not UI chrome, and is its own stage.

footer.quote: "I hope for people to hold the book in their hands someday, and to sit on the shelves."

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.lede: Thoughts on a story, the site, or anything else — this goes straight to my inbox.
feedback.notice: This form opens your own email app with the message ready to send to {recipient} — nothing is sent from this page, and nothing is stored. No email app? Use the copy buttons under the form. Please pick the subject that fits, so your message isn't lost in a crowded inbox.
feedback.namePlaceholder: So I know who to thank
feedback.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — the address is {recipient}.
feedback.sendHint: Send it from any email service you like.

notFound.title: That page isn't here
notFound.lede: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. The stories are all still where they were.
